subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname default contract, or should instance identity wait for the canonical resource-identity design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071?
rationale: The choice affects operator-facing env surface, telemetry privacy, uniqueness semantics, and the long-term OpenClaw resource identity contract, which are product/API decisions rather than a mechanical patch fix.

options.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
options.body: Remove the custom env/hostname path and implement instance identity through standard OTel resource attributes or the approved OpenClaw identity seam from the canonical issue.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID`, but require explicit docs, precedence rules, privacy expectations, and real exported-resource proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Or Close This PR
options.body: Keep the canonical issue as the owner until maintainers settle stable instance identity and invite a narrower replacement PR afterward.

recommendation.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env/hostname path and implement instance identity through standard OTel resource attributes or the approved OpenClaw identity seam from the canonical issue.
